verdict.rationale: Published support response times and escalation paths per plan tier are a fair question for a cloud application platform like Render, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no documentation of support SLAs, response-time guarantees, or escalation procedures for any plan. One community comment praising Render's 'better support' is general sentiment and does not establish guaranteed response times.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I know the guaranteed support response times and escalation paths for my plan tier
